controls: Same tasks, model, decoding, agent token/round limits, updater and original rubric as course-v1.2. Three strategies always share judge and recovery settings.
judge: Original rubric saved verbatim; append concise-counts-v1 format contract plus deterministic counts of tool-call proposals, observed results, errors and unanswered proposals (no scores or redundancy labels). Five rating slots; at most two logical attempts per slot, with one identical HTTP retry each for connection/429/5xx. Accept first valid rating, never the highest. Max 20 judge HTTP requests per trajectory. Counts survive resume.
persistence: Request/response/retry/outcome records immutable. Completed execution checkpoint permits judge-only resume. Prior aggregates retained in revisions. No blind replay of agent or tool side effects; interruption before a completed execution checkpoint stays interrupted.
transport: Judge pauses after two consecutive exhausted logical transport requests. Matrix sees the pause and starts no further cells. Agent/updater transport failures retain existing per-request limits and outer circuit breaker. Resume does not reset judge attempt budgets.
netlify: User confirms CLI account/site. Same HTML and site within a workspace reuse the deployment; URL checks can resume. Unknown deploy outcome blocks automatic resubmission. Strict HTTP200 + content hash; verification attempts preserved.

development_probe.gate: Four predefined exposed-development prompts; original rubric prefix unchanged, valid first or bounded recovered output, inspect counts/reasons against source trajectory. No tuning or selection by score. Then one live task139 cell with real MCP, agent and judge.

first_candidate.semantic_gate: failed: tool totals 24/24/30/44 versus recorded 29/27/32/31; retained without score replacement

accepted_candidate.gate: 4/4 first-attempt valid; recorded denominators correct; subjective attribution and rubric ambiguity disclosed

arms: same structural records; roll back only unrelated descriptions to Early

history: All previous success/failure evidence immutable. Do not backfill old missing cells.

verification.counts_probe: 4/4 valid first attempts; denominator checks passed; subjective judge uncertainty retained
